purpose: Invisible host-local developer observer watches six real-client AI hunters and one real-client ghost in a normal authoritative multiplayer match
visibility: Developer-only launcher; never exposed in normal public game menu

participantModel.distinction: 8 conceptual roles, 7 actual network gameplay peers initially; admin may become a separate development-only socket later

modules.name: DevMatchSession
modules.responsibility: Start host, join/ready 7 real LanClient peers, own teardown and reproducible scenario

modules.name: DevHunterClientAi
modules.authority: Per-client received frames and normal LanClient commands
modules.responsibility: Independent investigative goals; actual gear, scans, evidence, ritual, and movement

modules.name: DevGhostClientAi
modules.authority: Filtered ghost-seat frames and normal LanClient commands
modules.responsibility: Real ghost occupancy and human-equivalent control via ghost, movement and frenzy commands

modules.name: DevAdminSnapshot
modules.authority: Read-only LanHost state on authoritative tick
modules.responsibility: All bodies/ghosts/collision/evidence/true rules/equipment/AI intents; immutable 2–5Hz observer feed

modules.name: DevAdminPanel
modules.responsibility: Free-fly, x-ray hitboxes, top-down, follow, floor slices, mission and evidence inspector

modules.name: DevMatchController
modules.responsibility: Start/stop/clean restart, pause/resume/single-step, test-only controls auditable and clearly labeled

modules.name: DevMatchRecorder
modules.authority: Authoritative tick, bot command acknowledgements and game renderer
modules.responsibility: Time-stamped JSONL/CSV/PNG; match outcome/timeout/exceptions; bounded artifact output

phases.name: Harness and seat correctness
phases.acceptance: H1–H6 and GHOST connect via real LanClient; ADMIN does not affect player count or round outcome

phases.name: Observer/overlay truth
phases.acceptance: All poses/hitboxes/evidence read from host on one tick; x-ray and free-fly do not affect world or normal client projections

phases.name: Six autonomous investigators
phases.acceptance: Independent real player actions: travel, tools, notes, identify, ward, ritual, extraction; no direct server/world mutations

phases.name: Ghost in real player seat
phases.acceptance: GHOST bot sends actual player commands; absent-ghost AI does not concurrently control ghost; original host legality wins

phases.name: Developer controls and instrumentation
phases.acceptance: Host pause/resume/step coherent across simulation; action traces distinguish game actions from admin injections

phases.name: Windows workflow
phases.acceptance: Real local TCP match, 7 actual bot peers and admin observer, bounded transcript, screenshot, profiler and outcome artifacts

acceptance: Each bot has independently assigned real normal-player seat
Admin can see behind geometry and free-fly without simulating a ghost/hunter avatar
No ghost truth leaks into normal hunter/ghost bot decision inputs
Ghost bot occupies GHOST seat and submits commands, not relying silently on empty-seat AI
Scenarios differentiate completed round, timeout, refusal, crash, and startup failure
Capture actual renderer screenshots and authoritative diagnostic trace
Cosmetic and balance diagnostics are not release blockers

initialWorkflow.dependencies: Game runtime and actual assets; no Blender or Chocolatey required to play
